nonblocking_findings.title: Restore exactness flag exceeds the explicit optimizer comparison
nonblocking_findings.finding: BytesIO serializes and reloads both states; the code checks ten optimizer states at step two and exact head outputs, but does not compare all optimizer moments/parameter-group fields or execute a resumed update. No restore failure is demonstrated.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Interpret success as in-memory loading plus the explicit step/output checks; do not claim independently verified exact optimizer contents or continuation equivalence.

nonblocking_findings.title: Gradient witness does not measure the incoming learned geometry-query route
nonblocking_findings.finding: Constructed query is not a requires-grad input. The witness checks coarse center/size derivatives, whole-evidence derivatives and their isolated Text/Query Mask/alpha route, plus selected inner-head gradients after the first update.
nonblocking_findings.impact: These are standalone mathematical wiring assertions; full-model upstream parameter gradients and loss/accuracy improvement remain untested.

nonblocking_findings.title: Native loss_boxes extraction is not the complete native training objective
nonblocking_findings.finding: One constructed target uses center +0.02 and size *1.07 with fixed candidate-zero correspondence and count one. The witness objective is 10*bbox + 2*giou. Full native training additionally matches targets, aggregates decoder prefixes, divides that block by decoder count plus one and adds other losses.
nonblocking_findings.impact: No actual Hungarian/G qualification, active normalization-policy validation or real-fit budget claim follows.

nonblocking_findings.title: Capacity equality is parameter-count equality with an intended information-off control
nonblocking_findings.finding: Both arms have 400614 parameters in ten tensors and the same provider/local support. Zeroing 109 input columns leaves their 31392 aggregate weights without data signal through those columns in the local arm.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Do not describe this as proven equal actively used functional capacity; it matches the specified same-shape information intervention.

nonblocking_findings.title: Geometry statistics are detached and semantic invocation preservation is not training invariance
nonblocking_findings.finding: Current XYZ/SP geometry is consumed on CPU, with detached conditioning/layout and undetached final coarse residual parents and Mask/alpha routes. Native semantic invocation/fields are not rewritten, but upstream shared learning can alter semantics after updates.
nonblocking_findings.impact: No differentiated CPU geometry, frozen semantic behavior across training, CUDA feasibility or performance conclusion is supported.
